items.reading:
STREAMING-TEXT-01: its look (word fades in blue over 500 ms, settles to ink over 700 ms, pulsing blue caret) is the chat reply's streaming animation, drawn by CSS transitions in markdown-text.css on Streamdown's word spans and caret prop inside MarkdownText (ui-v0.5.112). The Element itself renders one plain

that drops line breaks and has no markdown, so it cannot be the reply renderer and Home never imports it; the scan reads it as not implemented. It tints the newest two words by position; here a word is tinted until the next delta restamps it.
